comment: No source is published. The manual says the voice count is taken from the polyphony of the Main CV input; it is instead the widest channel count across seven jacks — the two oscillator CV inputs, the VCF CV input, the two envelope gate inputs and the main CV and gate inputs — clamped to sixteen and at least one. A constant of 1.0, which is the whole scale, stands in for the VEL/EXT jack when it is unpatched; every input is scaled by 0.1 on the way into the DSP and every output by 10 on the way out. The coarse tuning range of two octaves either way is the maker's manual; 440Hz is the maker's own figure, from the port tooltip.
